how_to_read.matched: same number of cells as the simulator in each step: compares where, not how much
how_to_read.own: the model's own number of cells (area scale x summed probabilities): compares where and how much
how_to_read.even_growth: even_growth_recall / even_growth_iou: the published baseline, same count as each row's model, spread evenly from the active perimeter
how_to_read.step_ap: average precision of the model's ranking of candidate cells within 6 km, averaged over steps; needs no cell count
how_to_read.difference_from_simulator: mean over steps of (model - simulator), 95% interval from 2000 bootstrap resamples of fires
